contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_search_songs_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `search_songs` BEGIN DELETE FROM `search_songs_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_search_songs_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `search_songs` BEGIN DELETE FROM `search_songs_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_search_songs_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `search_songs` BEGIN INSERT INTO `search_songs_fts`(`docid`, `titleNorm`, `filmNorm`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`titleNorm`, NEW.`filmNorm`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_search_songs_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `search_songs` BEGIN INSERT INTO `search_songs_fts`(`docid`, `titleNorm`, `filmNorm`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`titleNorm`, NEW.`filmNorm`); END
